name: Stickier
description:
Old-school sticky notes … with a few new tricks.

• sync notes between all of your macOS and iOS devices
• browse recent revisions of notes
• italic/bold/underline/strikethrough text
• checkboxes and links
• customizable font and colors
• custom background images
• optional menu bar access
• global shortcut key for quick notes
• collapsible and floating (always-on-top) note windows
• snap-to-grid option to keep windows tidy

The companion Stickier Mobile app is available in the ios App Store.
